name: Cassava rolled in rice paper
nameVi: khoai mì quết cuốn bánh tráng
summary: Cassava boiled in coconut water, mashed with sugar, salt, and scallion oil, then rolled in rice paper with herbs and pork or shrimp. The dip is garlic fish sauce, with chili in one wording.
origin: Củ Chi. Báo Quốc tế, on 11 Aug 2024, describes khoai mì quết cuốn bánh tráng and calls it a dish of this district.
howToEat: Boil the cassava in fresh coconut water, mash it with sugar, salt, and scallion oil, and spoon it onto rice paper with herbs and sliced boiled pork or fried shrimp.
One wording of the dip is mắm tỏi ớt. The other is mắm tỏi. Both stay.
The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Cassava rolled in rice paper in Cu Chi
seoDescription: Mashed cassava in rice paper with herbs and pork or shrimp, and a garlic fish-sauce dip.
